sources.document: Hollywood Boulevard Commercial and Entertainment District nomination
sources.findings: Roosevelt: Spanish Colonial Revival, asymmetrical T plan, grouped arched windows with columnettes, wrought iron balconies, pierced concrete grilles, Churrigueresque facade ornament and red tile roof. Registration's older date is superseded for opening by Academy/owner sources.
Twelve-storey Roosevelt opened 1927 and hosted first Academy Awards in 1929. Historic facade image examined for restrained upper arches, regular square windows and roof sign support.
sources.visual_limit: Image spans early to mid 20th century: Cinegrill signage is excluded from 1930 model.

sources.findings: Opening 1927 and original Spanish Colonial interior identity corroborated. Later pool artwork, renovations and modern venue signage excluded.

sources.institution: PBS SoCal; archival photographs credited to Security Pacific National Bank Collection / Los Angeles Public Library
sources.findings: Mission design by Dennis and Farwell; historic verandas and rambling hotel retained into 1930. Unbuilt Italian Renaissance replacement excluded.
sources.visual_observations: Circa-1930 aerial shows long low main frontage, several shaped Mission gables and dark hipped/low pitched roofs; corner view shows round porch columns, dark balustrades, square upper windows and arched lower windows.

interpretation.dimensions: SPEC fixed collision boxes win over real historic T plan and irregular original hotel. Roosevelt is compressed to seven readable floors, all four main planes fill74x58x24. HollywoodHotel separates main/wings/courtyard wall to prescribed boxes.
interpretation.courtyard: Main rear facade and both wing long faces are fully finished with veranda/French-door rhythms; no navigable interior or ceiling needed.
interpretation.palette: Warm cream stucco, terracotta tile accents, muted slate brown broad roofs on HollywoodHotel, bottle-green striped canvas awnings and dark timber/iron details.
interpretation.letters: All lettering uses separate sign cards; backing geometry stays blank.
interpretation.reference_policy: Historic photographs are research reference only, never copied into runtime textures.
